title: Car Fleet
description: There are n cars going to the same destination along a one-lane road. You are given two integer arrays position and speed where position[i] is the position of the ith car and speed[i] is the speed. A car can never pass another car ahead of it but can catch up and form a fleet. Return the number of car fleets that will arrive at the destination.
